# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively release security updates and bug fixes for the latest version of `simplified-mojang-jsons`.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| `0.x.x` | ✅        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability or a critical exploit within **Simplified Mojang JSONs**, please do not open a public issue.

Instead, please report security vulnerabilities by opening a private disclosure or contacting the maintainer directly through [GitHub](https://github.com/HaJuegos).

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept code.
- Impact on projects utilizing the library.

We will review your report and respond as quickly as possible to address the issue.
